name: email-tool
description: Read, search, draft and send email over IMAP/SMTP.
long_description: Lets Claude read, search, draft and send email in your own mailboxes. Leave every field below blank and select Install. Then ask Claude: "add my mailbox". A page opens in your browser where you choose Gmail, Outlook or another mailbox and sign in. Your password never passes through Claude.

name.title: Mailbox name
name.description: Optional, for IT staff. Leave blank.

address.title: Email address
address.description: Optional, for IT staff. Leave blank and add mailboxes by asking Claude: "add my mailbox".

imap_host.title: IMAP server
imap_host.description: Optional, for IT staff. Leave blank.

imap_port.title: IMAP port (TLS)
imap_port.description: Optional, for IT staff. Leave blank.

smtp_host.title: SMTP server
smtp_host.description: Optional, for IT staff. Leave blank.

smtp_port.title: SMTP port
smtp_port.description: Optional, for IT staff. Leave blank.

password.title: Password
password.description: Optional, for IT staff. Leave blank.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: Mailboxes on this machine and whether each can log in (password stored, or signed in)

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search by sender, subject, body, date or Gmail query

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: One message in full, without marking it read

tools.name: save_attachment
tools.description: Save one attachment of a message into a folder you name

tools.name: add_mailbox
tools.description: Add a mailbox on a setup page in your browser, no terminal needed

tools.name: report_problem
tools.description: Build a problem report for the maintainer, with nothing private in it; sends nothing

tools.name: email_problem_report
tools.description: Email a problem report to the maintainer, after you approve the exact text
